CBFT.description: Bending Coefficient Cb (CBFT). Fields set the lateral-torsional buckling bending coefficient Cb: either auto-calculated by the program or a user value.

AUTO_CAL.description: Auto Calculate by Program. If true, Cb is computed by the program and VALUE is ignored (stored as 0.0).

VALUE.description: [AUTO_CAL=false] Bending Coefficient (Cb) value. Must satisfy 1.0 <= VALUE <= 2.3; ignored when AUTO_CAL is true.
